task: Provide a recipe for vegetarian lasagna with more than 100 reviews and a rating of at least 4.5 stars suitable for 6 people.
final_answer:
## Recipe Found: Easy Vegetarian Spinach Lasagna

**Source:** [Allrecipes](https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/229764/easy-vegetarian-spinach-lasagna/)

**Match Criteria:**
- Vegetarian: ✓
- Rating: **4.6 stars** (≥ 4.5)
- Ratings/Reviews: **117** (> 100)
- Servings: **6**

**Prep Time:** 20 mins | **Cook Time:** 1 hr | **Total Time:** 1 hr 25 mins | **Calories:** 305 kcal

### Ingredients
- Cooking spray
- Salt and ground black pepper to taste
- 10 ounces fresh spinach
- 9 lasagna noodles
- 1 (8 ounce) container ricotta cheese
- 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese, divided
- 1 large egg, lightly beaten
- 1 pinch ground nutmeg
- 1 cup pasta sauce
- ¼ cup grated Parmesan cheese

### Directions
1. **Preheat** the oven to 400°F (200°C). Spray a 1½-quart casserole dish with cooking spray. Set aside.
2. **Boil spinach:** Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Place spinach in the water and boil until wilted and tender, about 2 minutes. Remove spinach with a slotted spoon and set aside.
3. **Cook noodles:** Cook lasagna noodles in the same boiling water, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 8 minutes. Drain.
4. **Mix filling:** Combine spinach, ricotta cheese, ½ cup shredded mozzarella, egg, nutmeg, basil, salt, and black pepper in a bowl until well combined.
5. **Layer:** Spread ¼ cup pasta sauce on the bottom of the prepared dish. Top with 3 lasagna noodles, ½ of the ricotta mixture, and ¼ cup pasta sauce. Repeat layers. Finish with remaining sauce, mozzarella, and Parmesan.
6. **Bake** covered for 45 minutes, then uncovered until bubbly and golden. Let rest 5 minutes before slicing.

final_answer:
I have the complete cooling step. The final step (step 9) is "Store in an airtight container or serve immediately and enjoy!" I now have all the information needed for the recipe.

Here is the complete recipe:

# Best Chocolate Chip Cookies (Allrecipes #10813)
*Rating: 4.6 stars from 19,463 reviews · Prep: 20 min · Cook: 10 min · Total: 30 min · Yield: 4 dozen (48 cookies)*

## Ingredients
1. 1 cup butter, softened
2. 1 cup white sugar
3. 1 cup packed brown sugar
4. 2 large eggs
5. 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
6. 1 teaspoon baking soda
7. 2 teaspoons hot water
8. ½ teaspoon salt
9. 3 cups all-purpose flour
10. 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
11. 1 cup chopped walnuts (optional)

## Directions
1. **Gather ingredients** — Make sure butter is softened and eggs are at room temperature.
2. **Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).** In a large bowl, beat butter, white sugar, and brown sugar with an electric mixer until smooth and creamy.
3. **Beat in eggs one at a time**, then stir in vanilla.
4. **Dissolve baking soda in hot water**; add to the batter along with the salt. Mix until combined.
5. **Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and walnuts** until a soft dough forms.
6. **Drop rounded spoonfuls of dough** about 2 inches apart onto ungreased baking sheets.
7. **Bake in the preheated oven** until edges are lightly browned, about 10 minutes.
8. **Cool on the baking sheets** briefly before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.
9. **Store in an airtight container** or serve immediately and enjoy.

task: Choose a dessert recipe on Allrecipes with a prep time of less than 30 minutes, has chocolate as an ingredient, and has a user rating of 4 stars or higher. Provide the name of the recipe, ingredients list, and step-by-step instructions.
final_answer:
## Recipe: Chocolate Éclair Dessert

**Source:** https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/19009/chocolate-eclair-dessert/

**Why it qualifies:**
- ⭐ **Rating:** 4.8 stars (1,589 ratings) — ≥ 4 stars ✓
- ⏱ **Prep Time:** 15 minutes — < 30 minutes ✓
- 🍫 **Contains chocolate:** Yes (chocolate frosting) ✓
- **Total Time:** 2 hrs 15 mins (includes 2 hr chill)
- **Servings:** 12 | **Yield:** 1 (9x13-inch) pan

### Ingredients
1. 2 individual packages graham crackers
2. 3 cups cold milk
3. 2 (3 ounce) packages instant vanilla pudding mix
4. 1 (8 ounce) container frozen whipped topping, thawed
5. 1 (16 ounce) package prepared chocolate frosting

### Step-by-Step Instructions
1. **Gather all ingredients.**
2. **Line the bottom of a 9x13-inch pan** with a single layer of graham crackers.
3. **Combine cold milk and pudding** in a large bowl; whisk briskly for 2 minutes.
4. **Mix whipped topping** into the pudding mixture until combined.
5. **Spread 1/2 of the pudding mixture** over the graham cracker layer.
6. **Top with another layer of graham crackers.** Cover with remaining pudding. Top with a final layer of graham crackers.
7. **Frost the top layer** with chocolate frosting.
8. **Refrigerate for at least 2 hours** before serving. This will allow graham crackers time to soften.

## Recipe: Quinoa and Black Bean Chili
**URL:** https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/217002/quinoa-and-black-bean-chili/

### Verification Against Criteria
- **Rating:** 4.6 stars ✓ (≥ 4 stars)
- **Reviews:** 478 ratings ✓ (≥ 50 reviews)
- **Vegetarian:** ✓
- **High-Protein:** 12g protein per serving (quinoa is a complete protein + black beans)

### Cooking Time
- **Prep:** 30 minutes
- **Cook:** 30 minutes
- **Total:** 1 hour
- **Servings:** 10

### DescriptionA tasty vegetarian chili loaded with vegetables and spices, with jalapeño and chipotle peppers adding smoky heat.

### Ingredient List (18 ingredients)
1. 2 cups water
2. 1 cup uncooked quinoa, rinsed
3. 1 tablespoon vegetable oil
4. 1 onion, chopped
5. 4 cloves garlic, chopped
6. 1 tablespoon chili powder
7. 1 tablespoon ground cumin
8. 2 (19 oz) cans black beans, rinsed and drained
9. 1 (28 oz) can crushed tomatoes
10. 1 green bell pepper, chopped
11. 1 red bell pepper, chopped
12. 1 zucchini, chopped
13. 1 jalapeño pepper, seeded and minced
14. 1 tablespoon minced chipotle peppers in adobo sauce
15. 1 teaspoon dried oregano
16. Salt and ground black pepper, to taste
17. 1 cup frozen corn
18. ¼ cup chopped fresh cilantro

### Cooking Steps
1. **Cook the quinoa:** Bring water and quinoa to a boil in a saucepan over high heat. Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer until quinoa is tender and water has been absorbed, about 15–20 minutes. Set aside.
2. **Build the chili:** Meanwhile, heat oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add onion and stir until softened and translucent (about 5 minutes). Add garlic, chili powder, and cumin; cook 1 minute to release flavors. Stir in black beans, tomatoes, bell peppers, zucchini, jalapeño, chipotle pepper, and oregano. Season with salt and pepper. Bring to a simmer over high heat, then reduce to medium-low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes.
3. **Combine and serve:** Stir in the cooked quinoa and corn. Cook until corn is heated through, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat, stir in cilantro, and serve.

final_answer:
## Recipe Found: **Indian Chicken Curry (Murgh Kari)**

**Source:** https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/212721/indian-chicken-curry-murgh-kari/

### Recipe Stats
- **Rating:** 4.7 out of 5 stars
- **Reviews:** 1,012 (well above the 30-review threshold)
- **Ratings:** 1,291 total

### Preparation & Timing
- **Prep Time:** 20 minutes
- **Cook Time:** 40 minutes
- **Total Time:** 1 hour
- **Servings:** 6- **Author:** swarsh04

### Ingredients
- 2 pounds skinless, boneless chicken breast halves
- 2 teaspoons salt
- 3 tablespoons cooking oil (or as needed)
- 1 ½ cups chopped onion
- 1 tablespoon minced garlic
- 1 ½ teaspoons minced fresh ginger root
- 1 tablespoon curry powder
- 1 teaspoon ground cumin
- 1 teaspoon ground turmeric
- 1 teaspoon ground coriander
- 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper
- 1 tablespoon water
- 1 (15 ounce) can crushed tomatoes
- 1 cup plain yogurt
- 1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro
- 1 teaspoon salt
- ½ cup water
- 1 teaspoon garam masala
- 1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro
- 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice

### Cooking Instructions
1. **Gather all ingredients.**
2. **Brown the chicken:** Sprinkle chicken breasts with 2 teaspoons salt. Heat 1–2 tablespoons oil in a large skillet over high heat. Brown chicken in batches (adding oil as needed) until partially cooked and golden on all sides. Transfer to a plate and set aside.
3. **Sauté aromatics:** Reduce heat to medium. Add onion, garlic, and ginger to the remaining oil. Cook and stir until onion is soft and translucent, 5–8 minutes. Stir in curry powder, cumin, turmeric, coriander, cayenne, and 1 tablespoon of water; heat together for about 1 minute while stirring.
4. **Build the sauce:** Add crushed tomatoes, yogurt, 1 tablespoon chopped cilantro, and 1 teaspoon salt to the skillet; stir to combine.
5. **Combine and simmer:** Return the chicken breasts to the skillet with their juices. Pour in ½ cup water and bring to a boil, turning chicken to coat with the sauce. Sprinkle garam masala and 1 tablespoon cilantro over the chicken.
6. **Finish cooking:** Cover and simmer until chicken is no longer pink inside and juices run clear (internal temperature 165°F / 74°C), about 20 minutes.
7. **Serve:** Drizzle with fresh lemon juice and enjoy.

## Vegan Brownies — Allrecipes

**Recipe:** [Vegan Brownies](https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/68436/vegan-brownies/) by Allrecipes (submitted by SANDYWIFEY31S)

**Qualifying stats:**
- **Rating:** 4.6 ★
- **Reviews:** 835 (with 978 total ratings)

### Ingredients (8 total)
1. 2 cups unbleached all-purpose flour
2. 2 cups white sugar
3. 0.75 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
4. 1 teaspoon baking powder
5. 1 teaspoon salt
6. 1 cup water (or coffee)
7. 1 cup vegetable oil
8. 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

### Times & Yield
| | |
|---|---|
| Prep | 15 mins |
| Cook | 30 mins |
| Additional (cooling) | 10 mins |
| **Total** | **55 mins** |
| Servings | 15 |

### Preparation Overview
1. **Prep the pan:** Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish with baking spray and line the bottom with parchment paper.
2. **Mix dry ingredients:** In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, cocoa powder, baking powder, and salt until well combined.
3. **Add wet ingredients:** Pour in the water (or coffee for a deeper flavor), vegetable oil, and vanilla, then mix until the batter is smooth. Spread it evenly in the prepared dish.
4. **Bake:** Place in the preheated oven for about 30 minutes, until the top is no longer shiny and the center feels just set when gently pressed.
5. **Cool & serve:** Let cool for at least 10 minutes before cutting into 15 squares.

**About the recipe:** These vegan brownies use cocoa powder for a rich, gooey, chocolatey treat with no eggs or dairy — great for those with allergies. For firmer brownies, bake a bit longer than the recommended time.

task: Search for a Mediterranean-style grilled fish recipe on Allrecipes that includes ingredients like olives, has at least a 4-star rating, and more than 25 reviews. Detail the ingredients, cooking method, and total time required for preparation and cooking.
final_answer:
I have all the details I need. Here's my answer:

## Recipe Found: Mediterranean Stuffed Swordfish

**Source:** https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/152264/mediterranean-stuffed-swordfish/

### Match Against Criteria
- ✅ **Mediterranean-style** (Greek-inspired)
- ✅ **Grilled** (instructions call for outdoor grill)
- ✅ **4.6-star rating** (above 4 stars)
- ✅ **46 Reviews** (above 25)
- ⚠️ **"Ingredients like olives"** — recipe uses olive oil, feta cheese, lemon, garlic, and herbs (Mediterranean staples), but does not contain whole olives. The closest match containing literal **kalamata olives** is "Easy Mediterranean Fish," but that recipe is baked in foil, not grilled.

### Ingredients
- 1 (8 oz) swordfish steak (~2 inches thick)
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice
- 1 tsp olive oil
- 1 clove garlic, minced
- 2 cups fresh spinach (rinsed, dried, torn)
- ¼ cup crumbled feta cheese

### Cooking Method (Grilling)
1. Preheat outdoor grill to high heat and lightly oil the grate.
2. Cut a slit in the swordfish steak to create a pocket (open on one side only).
3. Mix 1 tbsp olive oil with lemon juice; rub the fish.
4. Sauté garlic in 1 tsp olive oil, wilt the spinach, then stuff into the pocket along with the feta.
5. Grill ~8 minutes per side, until the fish is opaque and flakes easily (internal temp ~145°F).

### Total Time
- **Prep:** 15 minutes
- **Cook:** 20 minutes
- **Total:** **35 minutes** (2 servings)

task: Find a recipe for a vegan smoothie bowl on Allrecipes that includes bananas and leaves, has more than 20 reviews, and a rating of at least 4 stars. Provide a list of ingredients, preparation time, and a summary of the recipe steps.
final_answer:
Based on my thorough search of Allrecipes, here is my finding:

## Best Match: **Blueberry Smoothie Bowl**

**URL:** https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/245208/blueberry-smoothie-bowl/

**Criteria Match:**
- Vegan: ✓ (all plant-based: blueberry, banana, cashew butter, almonds, coconut)
- Smoothie bowl: ✓
- Includes bananas: ✓
- More than 20 reviews: ✓ (23 ratings)
- Rating ≥ 4 stars: ✓ (4.7 stars)
- Includes "leaves": ✗ — **No leafy greens (spinach, kale, mint, basil) in the ingredients**

### Ingredients
- 1 cup frozen blueberries
- ½ banana
- 2 tablespoons water
- 1 tablespoon cashew butter
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- *Toppings:* ½ banana (sliced), 1 tablespoon sliced almonds, 1 tablespoon unsweetened shredded coconut

### Preparation Time
- **Prep Time:** 10 minutes
- **Total Time:** 10 minutes
- **Yield:** 1 smoothie bowl

### Recipe Steps (Summary)
1. **Blend:** Combine frozen blueberries, ½ banana, water, cashew butter, and vanilla extract in a blender until smooth; pour into a bowl.
2. **Top & Serve:** Garnish the smoothie bowl with the remaining sliced banana, almonds, and shredded coconut.

### Note on the "Leaves" Criterion
This recipe meets **4 out of 5** specified criteria. The recipes I found that include leafy greens (e.g., Green Smoothie Bowl with spinach, Strawberry Smoothie Bowl topped with mint) had **fewer than 20 reviews** (only 4 and 1 ratings respectively), so they did not meet the popularity threshold. No single recipe on Allrecipes perfectly satisfies every requirement you listed, so the Blueberry Smoothie Bowl is the closest and highest-rated vegan smoothie bowl with bananas available.

task: Search for a seafood paella recipe on Allrecipes with a minimum of 4.5 stars rating and at least 50 reviews. The recipe should include shrimp and mussels. Provide the ingredients, total time, and an overview of the preparation steps.
final_answer:
## Spanish Paella Recipe

I found a recipe that perfectly matches all criteria on Allrecipes:

**Recipe:** Spanish Paella (https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/12728/paella-i/)
- **Rating:** 4.7 stars ✓ (exceeds 4.5 minimum)
- **Ratings:** 178 ✓ (exceeds 50 minimum)
- **Reviews:** 124
- **Total Time:** 1 hr 30 mins (Prep: 45 mins | Cook: 45 mins)
- **Servings:** 6

### Ingredients (20 total)
1. 4 tablespoons olive oil
2. 1 onion, chopped
3. 2 cloves garlic, minced
4. 1 red bell pepper, chopped
5. 4 ounces Spanish chorizo, casing removed, diced
6. 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, cubed
7. 1 (12 oz) package uncooked Arborio rice
8. 5 cups chicken broth
9. ½ cup white wine
10. 1 sprig fresh thyme
11. 1 pinch saffron
12. Salt and ground black pepper to taste
13. 2 squid, cleaned and cut into 1-inch pieces
14. 2 tomatoes, seeded and chopped
15. ½ cup frozen peas
16. **12 large shrimp, peeled and deveined** ✓
17. **1 pound mussels, cleaned and debearded** ✓
18. ¼ cup chopped Italian flat leaf parsley
19. 8 lemon slices, for garnish

### Preparation Steps Overview
1. **Build the base:** Heat olive oil in a 14–15 inch paella pan over medium heat. Sauté onion, garlic, and pepper; add chorizo, chicken, and rice; cook 2–3 minutes.
2. **Simmer the rice:** Stir in 3½ cups stock, wine, thyme leaves, and saffron. Season with salt and pepper. Boil, then simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add more stock if rice isn't fully cooked (up to 2 cups additional).
3. **Add seafood:** Stir in squid, tomatoes, and peas; cook 2 minutes. Arrange shrimp and mussels on top. Cover with foil and steam 3–5 minutes.
4. **Serve:** Remove foil, scatter parsley over the top, and serve in the paella pan garnished with lemon wedges.

The recipe contains both shrimp and mussels, exceeds 4.5 stars, and has well over 50 reviews — all criteria met.

> "You can make sushi in advance, however, depending on what you use for the filling (tuna, salmon, etc) it will not last more than a day in the fridge."

So the practical guidance is to refrigerate leftover rolls and consume within **24 hours** — and avoid storing rolls whose fillings won't hold up beyond a day.

task: Browse black strollers within $100 to $200 on Amazon. Then find one Among these black strollers with over 20,000 reviews and a rating greater than 4 star.
final_answer:
Based on my thorough search of Amazon, here are my findings:

## Task Findings

**No black stroller in the $100-$200 price range on Amazon has over 20,000 reviews.**

After searching Amazon's Baby > Strollers category filtered for:
- Black color
- $100-$200 price range
- 4+ star rating
- Sorted by review count

The **top review counts** I found in this exact range were:
| Product | Rating | Reviews | Price |
|---------|--------|---------|-------|
| Graco® Gomax Frame Stroller | 4.8 | 9,152 | $143.99 |
| Safety 1st Smooth Ride Travel System | 4.6 | 8,519 | $199.99 |
| Graco Modes Pramette 3-in-1 | 4.6 | 7,124 | $199.99 |
| Baby Trend Expedition® Jogger Dash Black | 4.7 | 5,873 | $127.49 |
| Mompush Wiz 2-in-1 Bassinet Black | 4.6 | 3,677 | $159.99 |

All are well below 20,000 reviews.

## Closest Match (just outside price range)

The **Ingenuity 3D Mini Convenience Stroller (Blue/Black)** is the only stroller on Amazon with >20,000 reviews (23,539) and >4 stars (4.3). However, it is priced at **$69.99**, below the $100 threshold.

**Conclusion:** No product on Amazon simultaneously meets all four criteria (Black, $100-$200, >4 stars, >20,000 reviews). The task cannot be fully completed as stated.

task: Research the new features of the iOS 17 on Apple support and check its compatibility with the iPhone 12.
final_answer:
I have gathered all the necessary information from Apple's official support pages.

## iOS 17 Compatibility with iPhone 12: ✅ YES

According to Apple's official "iPhone models compatible with iOS 17" support page, **iPhone 12 is fully compatible with iOS 17**. All four iPhone 12 variants are supported:
- iPhone 12
- iPhone 12 mini
- iPhone 12 Pro
- iPhone 12 Pro Max

## New Features of iOS 17 (from Apple Support)

Based on Apple's official "iOS 17 New Features" support guide, key new features include:

**Communication**
- **Contact Posters** — Customizable posters shown to recipients when you call
- **Live Voicemail** — See real-time transcription of voicemails as they're being left; pick up mid-message
- **Messages updates** — Check In (notify contacts when you safely arrive at a destination), audio messages, improved search, inline location sharing
- **FaceTime** — Leave video messages, hand‑gesture reactions (heart, confetti, fireworks), hand off calls to other Apple devices
- **Phone** — Personalized calling experience

**Sharing & Connectivity**
- **NameDrop** — Bring two iPhones close together to share contact info
- **AirDrop** — Start AirDrop transfers and SharePlay sessions by bringing iPhones close together

**Lock Screen & Display**
- **StandBy** — Full‑screen, glanceable info experience while iPhone is charging in landscape
- **Interactive Widgets** — On Home Screen, Lock Screen, and StandBy

**Keyboard**
- Autocorrected words are temporarily underlined; tap to revert
- Inline predictive text — tap the space bar to complete word/sentence

**Maps**
- Download offline maps
- EV routing with preferred charging networks and real‑time station availability

**AirPlay (iOS 17.3)**
- Stream content directly to hotel‑room TVs

**Sources:** `support.apple.com/en-us/118723` (About iOS 17 Updates), `support.apple.com/guide/iphone/iphe3fa5df43/17.0/ios/17.0` (iPhone models compatible with iOS 17), and `support.apple.com/guide/iphone/iphfed2c4091/17.0/ios/17.0` (iOS 17 new features).

task: Compare the prices and chips for the iPhone 14 Pro and iPhone 15 Pro models directly from Apple's website.
final_answer:
Based on my research from Apple's iPhone Compare page (apple.com/iphone/compare/?modelList=iphone-14-pro,iphone-15-pro), here is the comparison:

## iPhone 14 Pro vs iPhone 15 Pro Comparison

| Spec | iPhone 14 Pro | iPhone 15 Pro |
|------|---------------|---------------|
| **Chip** | A16 Bionic chip | A17 Pro chip |
| **Price (Apple.com)** | Not available | Not available |

**Key findings from Apple's website:**

- **Chips**: iPhone 14 Pro uses the **A16 Bionic** chip, while iPhone 15 Pro uses the newer **A17 Pro** chip (Apple's first chip built on a 3nm process).
- **Prices**: Both models are listed as **"Not available"** on Apple's current website. The compare page shows "Available at authorized resellers" for both, meaning Apple no longer sells them directly — they have been discontinued.
- The page shows the **"—"** symbol for the price section of both phones, and the capacity rows display "Not available" for all storage tiers (128GB, 256GB, 512GB, 1TB).

Note: At their original launch, the iPhone 14 Pro started at $999 and the iPhone 15 Pro at $999, but Apple's current site no longer displays these prices for either model since they are discontinued.

task: When and where the Apple Vision Pro will be released.
final_answer:
Based on Apple's official press release dated October 15, 2025:

**Apple Vision Pro (M5) Release:**
- **Pre-orders:** Available on apple.com starting October 15, 2025
- **In-store availability:** Wednesday, October 22, 2025 (nationwide)
- **Location:** Apple Store locations across the United States (the press release refers to "nationwide" availability, with US Apple Store demos opening on launch day)

The original Apple Vision Pro (M2) launched February 2, 2024 in the US, then expanded to additional countries (China, Japan, Singapore, etc.) on June 28, 2024, the UK/Canada/Australia/Germany/France on July 12, 2024, South Korea and the UAE on November 15, 2024, and additional countries including Taiwan and Japan through 2025. The M5 upgrade launched in the US on October 22, 2025.

# Latest iPad Model: iPad Pro (M5)

**Models:** iPad Pro 11-inch and iPad Pro 13-inch

## Storage Options
- **256GB**
- **512GB**
- **1TB**
- **2TB**

(Note: 256GB/512GB models have 12GB unified memory; 1TB/2TB models have 16GB unified memory. Nano-texture display glass option is available only on 1TB and 2TB models.)

## Processor
- **Apple M5 chip**
  - **256GB/512GB models:** 9-core CPU (3 super cores + 6 efficiency cores), 10-core GPU with Neural Accelerators and hardware-accelerated ray tracing, 16-core Neural Engine, 153GB/s memory bandwidth, 12GB unified memory
  - **1TB/2TB models:** 10-core CPU (4 super cores + 6 efficiency cores), 10-core GPU with Neural Accelerators and hardware-accelerated ray tracing, 16-core Neural Engine, 153GB/s memory bandwidth, 16GB unified memory

## Display Features- **Ultra Retina XDR display** (Tandem OLED)
- **11-inch:** 2420-by-1668 resolution at 264 ppi
- **13-inch:** 2752-by-2064 resolution at 264 ppi
- **ProMotion technology** with adaptive refresh rates from 10Hz to 120Hz

- **SDR brightness:** 1000 nits max
- **XDR brightness:** 1000 nits max full screen, 1600 nits peak (HDR content only)

- **2,000,000:1 contrast ratio**
- Supports Apple Pencil Pro, Apple Pencil (USB-C), and Apple Pencil hover

## Additional Highlights
- Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be), Bluetooth 6, Apple N1 wireless chip
- Cellular models: Apple C1X modem, 5G (sub-6 GHz) with 4x4 MIMO
- Thunderbolt / USB 4 port (up to 40Gb/s)

- Apple Intelligence built in, runs iPadOS

final_answer:
I now have the answer. Apple's official solution for a forgotten Apple ID password is to visit iforgot.apple.com. Let me check what's available on this official password reset page to provide complete information.

## Answer

Apple's official solution for forgetting your Apple ID password is to use the **Apple Account recovery page at iforgot.apple.com**.

**Steps to reset your Apple ID password:**

1. Go to **iforgot.apple.com**
2. Enter your **Apple Account email address or phone number**
3. Follow the on-screen instructions to verify your identity. You may be asked to:
   - Answer your security questions
   - Use two-factor authentication (receive a code on a trusted device)
   - Use account recovery (if two-factor authentication isn't enabled)
4. Once verified, you can **reset your password**

**Additional resources:**
- The Apple Support page provides direct guidance: "Reset your Apple Account password at iforgot.apple.com"
- Apple also recommends setting up **two-factor authentication** to make future recovery easier
- If you're signed in to a trusted Apple device, you can also reset your password directly through **Settings** (on iPhone/iPad/Mac) instead of using the web

For direct help, the official recovery URL is: **https://iforgot.apple.com/**

task: How much does it cost to buy an ipad mini with 64GB storage and Wi-Fi + Cellular connectivity? (no engraving, no apple pencil, no smart folio, no apple trade-in).
final_answer:
I have the answer. Let me provide a clear response.

The current iPad mini (A17 Pro) on apple.com does **not** offer a 64GB storage option — the available storage tiers are only 128GB, 256GB, and 512GB.

For the closest equivalent configuration (Wi-Fi + Cellular, no engraving, no Apple Pencil, no Smart Folio, no Apple Trade-In):

- **128GB + Wi-Fi + Cellular: $749** (smallest storage available)
- 256GB + Wi-Fi + Cellular: $899
- 512GB + Wi-Fi + Cellular: $1,099

Apple discontinued the 64GB option when they refreshed the iPad mini to the A17 Pro model. There is no 64GB iPad mini currently sold on apple.com.

task: Find updates for Apple Watch Series 7,8,9 on Apple's website.
final_answer:
I now have all the information needed. Let me provide a comprehensive answer.

## Updates for Apple Watch Series 7, 8, and 9

Based on Apple's website, the latest Apple Watch software update is **watchOS 27**, released September 14, 2026.

### Compatibility Status (Critical Information)

**watchOS 27 is compatible with:**
- Apple Watch SE 3
- Apple Watch Series 9, 10, 11, 12
- Apple Watch Ultra 2, 3, 4

**Apple Watch Series 7 and Series 8 are NOT compatible with watchOS 27** — they do not appear in the supported devices list and have been dropped from major software updates.

**Apple Watch Series 9 IS compatible with watchOS 27** and receives all the new features.

### New Features in watchOS 27 (for Series 9)

- **Siri AI on Apple Watch** – A dedicated Siri app to revisit conversations and get broad world knowledge directly from your wrist
- **Workout Buddy in Spanish** (expanded from English-only) — now works without your iPhone nearby, and delivers new pace, distance, and workout duration insights
- **Even more accurate miles for indoor runs/walks** — improved motion tracking algorithms
- **New Smart Stack widget suggestions** that surface when relevant
- **Single-handed tap gesture** to open widgets
- **Design refinements** with updated Liquid Glass for better contrast and refraction
- **Call Context** – proactively surfaces relevant information from apps during calls
- **Expanded menstrual health support**

### Bottom Line

If you own a **Series 9**, you're getting all the new watchOS 27 features. If you own a **Series 7 or 8**, these watches are no longer supported by Apple's latest software updates. The compatibility requirement also notes watchOS 27 requires an iPhone 11 or later (or iPhone SE 2nd gen+) running iOS 27.
